Verses.1:
After this, I hear something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven singing.
"Alleluia! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
Verses.2:
for His judgments are trust and just.
He has judged the great harlot,
	who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality.
He has avenged the blood of his servants shed by her."
Verses.3:
And a second time they sang,
"Alleluia! And her smoke rises forever and ever."
Verses.4: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God, who sits on the throne. They cried, "Amen, Alleluia!"
Verses.5:
Then a voice came from the throne, saying,
"Praise our God,
	all you servants of the Lord,
you who fear him,
	both small and great."
Verses.6:
Then I heard something. It sounded like the voice of a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters, and like loud claps of thunder, saying,
"Alleluia! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns.
Verses.7:
Let us rejoice and exult and give glory to Him.
For the marriage of the Lamb has come,
	and His bride has made herself ready.
Verses.8:
Fine linen, bright and clean,
	was given to clothe herself in.
For her fine linen
	is the righteous acts of the saints."
Verses.9: Then he said to me, "Write this, 'Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding banquet of the Lamb.'" And he added, "These are the true words of God."
Verses.10: At this I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "Don't do that. I am a fellow servant of yours and your siblings who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."

Changes: 2025-04-12 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 1-10.
